verdict.rationale: Meltano is explicitly open source and self-hostable: docs state "You host and manage everything on your own servers" and "Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever," with pip/docker install instructions and CLI-driven project setup. Community confirms real-world self-hosted production use (GitLab Data Team) and open-source nature. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of self-hosting at scale beyond one case study, and no discussion of licensing edge cases restricting self-hosted core.
